pay_detail: Pre-apprenticeship may or may not be paid. Apprenticeship pays a wage scale that increases with experience. Tuition waiver while in the apprenticeship.
name: Durham Tech Apprenticeship Skills Achievement Program (ASAP)
what_you_do: Start with a pre-apprenticeship to try a field. Then move into an apprenticeship that mixes classes with on-the-job training. Apprentices earn wages that rise as their skills grow.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older. High school graduate, equivalency holder, or currently in a program leading to a diploma. GPA of 2.00 or above.
how_to_apply: Fill out the student interest form on the Durham Tech page. Or contact the Apprenticeship Coordinator, Dr. Norman Collins, at 919-536-7200 ext. 1402.
notes: Open to students 16 and up, including current high school students. Which fields are offered is not listed on this page.
